verdict.rationale: Termius documents generating 'Biometric keys' and securing connections with 'device-bound keys and biometric protection with Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics', which covers the core of the story; FIDO2 hardware keys are also supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that biometric keys are generated and stored in a hardware secure enclave/TPM (only implied by 'device-bound'), in-depth docs on how the keys are protected, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
